notes.critical_error: FACT|328 gives the 35B budget effect as -4.3 'from budget 4096 to 16384', which reads as the larger budget costing quality, but the report's -4.3 is rb4096 minus rb16384, i.e. the 16384 budget is 4.3 points better (significant).
